metadataRaw.title: Release THIS Muscle to Fix Your Sciatica
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe goes over the two main muscles associated with sciatica pain: the glutes and the piriformis.

When these muscles become strained and inflamed, they can compress the nearby sciatic nerve and cause pain across the back, buttocks, hips, and down the leg.

To fix this, we’ll go over easy exercises in this video that release muscle tension and help strengthen the muscles for both quick and long-lasting relief.

Each exercise works differently and is shown in different positions. To get the best results, go through them all and use the ones that give you the most relief.

Watch now and fix your sciatica!
